decisions.reason: The yogurt on fruit puree sits close to the firm's core cultured dairy know-how and has a clear early success signal in an award, so the firm can interpret the result and refine the product.
The flavoured organic cheese builds directly on the firm's cheese expertise and was featured prominently as a new launch, so it is worth further learning rather than an early withdrawal.
A semi-hard cheese wheel is very close to the established cheese range and its organic milk supply, so it carries low risk and fits existing knowledge.
The spicy cheese extends existing cheese competence, and its early results can be absorbed and acted on, though as a niche flavour it is somewhat more prone to range pruning.
The mild creamy soft cheese was presented as rounding off the new range and builds on related dairy know-how, so the firm has the capacity to develop it further.
Washed-rind soft cheese demands more specialised ripening knowledge and receives little visible promotion, which raises some risk, but it still fits the firm's cheese expansion and is kept.
